core_meaning.short_meaning: She who has performed the Hajj
core_meaning.primary_meaning: Hajjah is an Arabic-origin name meaning “She who has performed the Hajj”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hajjah corresponds to the Arabic form حاجة (Arabic root ح ج ج (ḥ-j-j); حاجّة (ḥājja)). Its core sense is pilgrim (one who performs the hajj). Hajjah is the feminine pilgrim title حاجّة (ḥājja) 'she who has performed the Hajj'. The source gave حجة, which is the different noun 'proof, argument'; corrected here. Same usage as hajja.
